lines.japanese: 「～ぁふ……くぁー、眠みー」
lines.english: “Yaaawn... God, I’m tired.”

lines.japanese: ソファーの下で、腕をＹの字に広げた。部屋が広いとあくびまででかくなる。
lines.english: I spread my arms into a Y on the floor by the sofa. A big room even made my yawns bigger.

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “Huh?!”

lines.japanese: 地上２８階から見下ろす柳木原の朝を窓辺で堪能していたパルさんが振りかえった。官公庁の超高層ビルを背負って、ぴかぴかのフローリングを歩いてくる。
lines.english: Paru, who had been savoring the morning view of Yanagihara from twenty-eight stories up, turned from the window. With the government high-rises at her back, she crossed the gleaming floor toward us.

lines.japanese: 「腑抜けたこと言ってんじゃないよ、真っ先に寝ちまったやつが」
lines.english: Don't give me that weak crap. You're the one who fell asleep first.

lines.japanese: 「え……あ、そっか。えーと、じゃあウソ、ぜんぜん眠くね」
lines.english: Huh...? Oh, right. Uh, then I lied. Not sleepy at all.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあってなんだ、じゃあって」
lines.english: “What do you mean, ‘then’?”

lines.japanese: 今度は逆サイドから反論が飛んできた。
lines.english: This time somebody shot back from the other side.

lines.japanese: 亜衣はテーブルの上に頬杖をつき、体を斜めに傾けた行儀悪い姿勢でテレビの大画面を眺めていた。
lines.english: Ai lounged at the table, cheek propped in one hand and body slanted sideways in a graceless sprawl as she watched the huge television.

lines.japanese: 「なに、隼人君ちゃんと寝たのォ？」
lines.english: “What, Hayato? Did you actually sleep?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　ばっ、てめ何うた──疑ってんだよ。超寝たっつーの。ガン寝したっつーの。なんだったら、いまからもっかい寝てみせんぞコラ。言っとくけど俺の歯軋りはハンパねーかんなコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “The hell? Wh-why are you doubting me? I slept. I was out cold. I'll go right back to sleep now and prove it if you want. And I'm warning you, I grind my teeth like you wouldn't believe, you hear me?”

lines.japanese: 「はい、はい」
lines.english: “Sure, sure.”

lines.japanese: よっこらせ、とババくさい声をこぼしてパルさんがテーブルの一辺に腰を下ろした。
lines.english: Paru went ‘heave-ho,’ sounding like an old lady, and sat down on one edge of the table.

lines.japanese: 朝の太陽と真横に並ぶ鳳家のリビング。白く霞んだ１２月の柳木原。誰が点けたんだか、流しっぱなしのテレビの中では、着ぐるみのヒーローが無数の怪人たち相手に豪快な殺陣を披露していた。
lines.english: The Ohtori living room floated level with the morning sun. December Yanagihara lay hazy and white below. Someone had left the television running, and on it a costumed hero was cutting a magnificent swath through a horde of monsters.

lines.japanese: 日曜の朝。この時刻、普段であればもう≪コックピット≫からとっくに降りているはずの俺は、この時間帯がちびっ子向けアニメや特撮番組の宝庫だったなんて今日初めて知った。
lines.english: Sunday morning. I was usually out of the *Cockpit* long before this hour. Until today, I’d had no idea it was packed with anime and live-action superhero shows for kids.

lines.japanese: もはや変わるタイミングは完全に逸してしまった。タカシには悪いけれど、今日だけはいましばらくこのまま成田隼人を続けさせてもらおう。
lines.english: I had completely missed my chance to change back. I felt bad for Takashi, but just for today I was going to remain Hayato Narita a while longer.

lines.japanese: まあ、これまでの人生でタカシにはそのぐらいの貸しは作ってきたつもりだし、鷲介にいたってはこのところ延長続きだったから俺を咎める権利なんてあるはずもない。
lines.english: I figured I had earned at least that much credit with Takashi over the course of our lives. As for Shusuke, he had been running overtime so often lately that he had no right whatsoever to complain.

lines.japanese: ただ気がかりと言えば、無断外泊なんて初めてのことだから小鳩が心配してないかってことだ。
lines.english: The only thing worrying me was Kobato. This was the first time I'd stayed out all night without telling her, so she might be worried.

lines.japanese: 「ねー、鳴ちゃんはー？」
lines.english: “Hey, where’s Naru?”

lines.japanese: 番組は正義のヒーローが敵の秘密基地に踊りこんだところでＣＭに入った。眠たげに突っ伏した亜衣が、テーブルの天板で潰れた声を出した。
lines.english: The hero had just barged into the enemy's secret base when the show cut to commercial. Ai lay sleepily facedown on the table and spoke into the tabletop, her voice all squashed.

lines.japanese: やつなら風呂場だ。汗（とか色んなもの）を流しに行った。しかし、もちろん俺は知らない振りをする。
lines.english: She was in the bath, washing off the sweat—and various other things. Naturally, I pretended not to know.

lines.japanese: 「さー。自分の部屋で寝てんじゃね」
lines.english: “Who knows. Probably asleep in her room.”

lines.japanese: 「シャワーだろ。ほら、向こうから音してんじゃない」
lines.english: “She's in the shower. You can hear it over there.”

lines.japanese: 「……うあ、びびったー」
lines.english: “...Whoa, that scared me.”

lines.japanese: 目を閉じかけた亜衣が跳ねおきた。突如鳴りだしたのはパルさんの荷物だった。
lines.english: Ai was almost asleep, then sprang up. Something in Paru's stuff had started ringing.

lines.japanese: 「あー、ごめんごめん」
lines.english: “Ah, sorry, sorry.”

lines.japanese: 俺たちが視線を向けると、パルさんは立ちあがってダイニングの方のテーブルへ走った。ピンクのバッグからピンクのケータイを引っぱりだして画面を開く。
lines.english: When we looked over, Paru rose and hurried to the dining table. She pulled a pink phone from a pink bag and flipped it open.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、エージか」
lines.english: “Oh, Eiji.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: ぽつりと、縁起の悪い名前がパルさんの口にのぼった。思わず俺は、見えない発信者にガンを飛ばす。
lines.english: Paru quietly said the unlucky name. I instinctively glared at the caller I couldn't see.

lines.japanese: 「んーだあいつ、こんな日曜の朝っぱらから……」
lines.english: “What's that guy want this early on a Sunday...?”

lines.japanese: どピンクの携帯電話は、パルさんの耳元でぺかぺかと七色に発光していた。
lines.english: The violently pink cell phone flashed through seven colors beside Paru's ear.

lines.japanese: 「あいよ。おう、おはよ……ああ、まったくだ、今日はいい朝だねぇ」
lines.english: “Yeah. Morning... Sure is. Beautiful morning today.”

lines.japanese: 「なに──え？　ああドラ？　はは、連絡付くも何もいま一緒だよ。あ？　やかましい、馬鹿な想像してんじゃないよ」
lines.english: “What—huh? Oh, Drac? Ha, never mind reaching him, he's right here. What? Shut up. Don't start imagining stupid things.”

lines.japanese: パルさんは喋りながら俺に目線だけよこす。いや、よこすな。冗談じゃない、エージに話なんかあるか。いない、いない、ドラはいない──俺はしかめ面を左右に振った。
lines.english: Paru kept talking and glanced my way. Don’t look at me. No chance in hell I had anything to say to Eiji. Not here, not here, Drac isn’t here—I shook my scowling face from side to side.

lines.japanese: トラブルメーカーに居留守を決めこんで頭を低くしていると、横にいた亜衣が興味薄げな気だるい声で尋ねてきた。
lines.english: I ducked low and pretended not to be home for the troublemaker. Beside me, Ai asked in a tired voice that barely sounded interested.

lines.japanese: 「なにー、だれー？」
lines.english: “Who is it?”

lines.japanese: 「あー。エージ」
lines.english: “Eiji.”

lines.japanese: 俺はあくびしながら答えた。
lines.english: I answered through a yawn.

lines.japanese: 「えー？　何してるひとー？」
lines.english: “What does he do?”

lines.japanese: 「何もしてないひと」
lines.english: “Nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「ニートか」
lines.english: “So he's a NEET?”

lines.japanese: 「つーかヒモ。パチスロと女の金で食ってるチンピラ」
lines.english: “More like a kept man. Two-bit punk living off slot machines and women's money.”

lines.japanese: 「うわー。え、でも隼人君の友達なんでしょ」
lines.english: “Wow. But he's your friend, right?”

lines.japanese: 「ちげーよ、たまに便利屋の仲介してもらってただけ。でもろくな仕事持ってこねーから、もう関わらないようにしてんの」
lines.english: “No. He just used to broker odd jobs for me. Never brought anything decent, so I'm trying not to deal with him anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「え。隼人君、仕事選べる立場なん？」
lines.english: “Wait. Are you in a position to be picky about work?”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: 「ドラ」
lines.english: “Drac.”

lines.japanese: 巨大ロボの暴れっぷりを眺めがら亜衣と話していたら、不意にパルさんがストラップだらけの携帯電話を突きだしてきた。まあ、なんとなく予想していた展開だけど。俺は電話の向こうに届いても構わない声で言った。
lines.english: I was talking with Ai and watching a giant robot rampage when Paru suddenly shoved her charm-covered phone at me. Yeah, I'd kinda seen this coming. Loud enough for Eiji to hear, I said:

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「エージ。あんたに替われって」
lines.english: “Eiji. He wants you.”

lines.japanese: 「やだよ。いないつってよ。あいつ持ってくんの、どうせろくでもねー仕事だもん」
lines.english: “No. Tell him I'm not here. Any job he brings me is gonna be garbage.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　あんた仕事選べる立場じゃないだろ」
lines.english: “What? You're hardly in a position to be picky about work.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえっつの」
lines.english: “I said shut up.”

lines.japanese: どいつもこいつもツッコミに芸がない。しかし、たしかに無職の俺には反論する材料が乏しい。仕方なく、突きだされたケータイをピンクの枝からもぎ取った。
lines.english: None of these people had any creativity in their comebacks. Still, unemployed me didn't have much ammo to shoot back with. So I yanked the phone off its pink branch.

lines.japanese: 「はいもしもし断る」
lines.english: “Hello, no thanks.”

lines.japanese: 「おおドラ。いや待てって、話ぐらい聞けって」
lines.english: “Hey, Drac. Wait. At least hear me out.”

lines.japanese: 「やだよ、めんどくさい」
lines.english: “No. It's a pain.”

lines.japanese: 「はッ、おまえ仕事選べる立場じゃないだろ」
lines.english: “Hah! You're hardly in a position to be picky about work.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、うるせうるせうるせっつんだよ」
lines.english: “That's why I keep telling everybody to shut up, shut up, shut up.”

lines.japanese: 「あーん？　なんだオイ、つれねーなあ。んなこと言ってっとアレだぞーおまえ、ぐふ、明け方パルさんとこ電話したらドラが出たって、みんなに言いふらしちゃうぞー？」
lines.english: Haaah? What's with you, man? So cooold. Keep that up and I'll, y'know—guhuh—tell everybody I called Paru's at dawn and Drac answered, okaaaay?

lines.japanese: 「んだ、その脅迫。異性を意識しはじめた小学５年生かてめえは」
lines.english: “What kind of threat is that? You a fifth-grader who just discovered the opposite sex?”

lines.japanese: 「はーん、いいのかー。誤解されんぞー。おまえ、みんなからひゅーひゅー言われんぞー」
lines.english: “Oh, is that so? People might get the wrong idea. Everybody's gonna whistle and tease you.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、パルさんにボコられておまえがひゅーひゅー言うだろ」
lines.english: “No. Paru will beat the crap out of you, and then you'll be the one wheezing.”

lines.japanese: 「かはは、まぁまぁ冗談はいんだよ」
lines.english: “Hah! Anyway, enough joking around.”

lines.japanese: 同感だ。俺は携帯電話を耳から離すと、冷静に通話終了ボタンを探した。
lines.english: Agreed. I took the phone from my ear and calmly searched for the end-call button.

lines.japanese: しかしそれを押すより先に、小さな穴から大きな声が漏れきこえた。
lines.english: But before I could press it, a big voice escaped the tiny speaker.

lines.japanese: 「頼むよドラ、今回はほんと安全な仕事だって！」
lines.english: “Come on, Drac. This one really is safe!”

lines.japanese: 「……あァ？　うそつけタコ」
lines.english: “...Huh? Bullshit, jackass.”

lines.japanese: パルさんのケータイを、老眼のじいさんみたいに手元から遠ざけて睨む。続けて叫ぶような声が聞こえた。
lines.english: I held Paru's phone away and glared at it like an old man with failing eyesight. Another shout came through.

lines.japanese: 「あんなー？　ちょっと自転車取りに行ってもらうだけなんだわー！」
lines.english: “Listen, all I need you to do is pick up a bicycle!”

lines.japanese: 「はッ、なにが自転車……」
lines.english: “Hah! What do you mean, a bicycle...”

lines.japanese: 「え、なに。なに、自転車取り行くって」
lines.english: “Wait, what? What do you mean, pick up a bicycle?”

lines.japanese: つい気になって、俺はふたたび電話を耳に当てた。
lines.english: Despite myself, I returned the phone to my ear.

lines.japanese: 「ああいや、こないださ、駅前に留めといたチャリ持ってかれちゃって」
lines.english: “Yeah, well, the other day I left my bike by the station and it got taken away.”

lines.japanese: 「駅前に留めといたチャリ」
lines.english: “A bike left by the station.”

lines.japanese: 繰りかえしてみる。なんだか引っかかる言葉だ。
lines.english: I repeated the phrase. Something about it snagged in my mind.

lines.japanese: 「なに。おまえもチャリ、パクられたの」
lines.english: “What, somebody stole your bike too?”

lines.japanese: 「あいやいや、パクられたっつーかさ。ほら。最近、区役所が放置自転車の撤去に力入れてんじゃん。ギバラの駅前なんか置いとくと、よく持ってかれんだよねえ」
lines.english: “No, not stolen exactly. You know how the ward office has been cracking down on abandoned bikes? Leave one near Gibara Station and they haul it away all the time.”
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: 思わず顎が落ちた。パルさんと亜衣が不思議そうにこちらを向いてる。
lines.english: My jaw dropped. Paru and Ai turned toward me, puzzled.

lines.japanese: 放置自転車の撤去……。
lines.english: The removal of abandoned bicycles...

lines.japanese: まさか……鳴も……。
lines.english: Surely... Naru too...?

lines.japanese: いや……いや、まさかな。はは。いくら鳴でも、そんな基本的な可能性を見落とすほど間抜けじゃあるまい。区の自転車保管所を最初に確認してきた上で、パクられた何だと騒いでるんだろう。
lines.english: No... no way, right? Haha. Even Naru couldn't be dumb enough to miss something that basic. She must've checked the ward bike impound first and only then started yelling about it being stolen.

lines.japanese: いや、でも……もしかしたら、ありうるかも……。
lines.english: But then... maybe it was possible...

lines.japanese: だって……鳴だし……。
lines.english: Because... Naru.

lines.japanese: 確認……しとくか……。
lines.english: Perhaps I should... check.

lines.japanese: 「なんで俺、引き取りに行かなきゃなんねンだけどー、ここんとこ忙しくて日中に時間取れねンだよ。金はちゃんと払うからさ、ちょっとおまえ、俺の代わりに行ってきてくんない？　あ、えっと、保管場所はー……」
lines.english: So I gotta go pick it up, but, y'know, I've been busy lately and can't get free during the day. I'll pay you, so could you maybe go for me? Oh, uh, the impound lot is...

lines.japanese: 耳元では相変わらず呑気な声が続いている。対して俺は溜息みたいな声を絞りだす。
lines.english: His carefree voice continued beside my ear. I squeezed out something like a sigh.

lines.japanese: 「あのさ……おまえさ……」
lines.english: “Listen... You...”

lines.japanese: 「んー？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「ここんとこずっと、電話で俺に頼もうとしてたのってそれ？」
lines.english: “Is that what you've been trying to ask me on the phone this whole time?”

lines.japanese: 「あー？　そうだけどー？」
lines.english: “Huh? Yeah?”

lines.japanese: 「……あのさ。あのおまえさ、そういう基本的なヒントはもっと早いうち言ってくんない」
lines.english: ...Listen. Hey, listen. Couldn't you maybe tell me basic clues like that a little sooner?

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　なに言ってんだおまえ。俺は何度も話そうとしただろ。おまえが聞こうとしなかっただけだっつーの」
lines.english: “What are you talking about? I tried to tell you over and over. You're the one who refused to listen.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ……そうだけどさあ……」
lines.english: “Well... yeah, but...”

lines.japanese: ひでえオチだ。
lines.english: What a shitty punch line.

lines.japanese: 放心した俺は、耳元でがーがー喚いていたエージの声をだらりと脇に落とした。
lines.english: Stunned, I let the phone—and Eiji's voice still squawking from it—droop to my side.

lines.japanese: 「あったー！」
lines.english: “There it is!”

lines.japanese: 鳴が歓喜の声をあげて飛びついた。各所から移送されてきた膨大な数の自転車が並ぶ中で、その背もたれ付きの真っ赤なチャリはひときわ異彩を放っていた。
lines.english: Naru cried out in delight and sprang toward it. Among the vast ranks of bicycles brought here from all over, her bright-red bike with a backrest stood out at once.

lines.japanese: 前に黒パインたちが用意した囮の餌と、たしかに同じ型だ。でも鳴が言ってたとおり、こいつには鼻っ面にポーチが付いてる。消防服みたいな素材の密閉型で、中の物はある程度の雨露ぐらい凌げそうだ。
lines.english: It was the same model as the decoy Black Pine and the others had prepared. But just as Naru had said, this one had a sealed pouch fixed to the front, made of something like the fabric of a firefighter’s uniform. Whatever was inside should have survived a little rain.

lines.japanese: 「これですー、これ私のですー」
lines.english: “This is it. This one is mine.”

lines.japanese: 鳴がサドルとハンドルに手をかけて車体を揺すると、保管所の年老いた係員はハハハと笑いながらそれをプレハブ建ての詰所まで転がしていった。
lines.english: Naru gripped the saddle and handlebars and rocked the frame. Laughing, the elderly attendant wheeled it toward the prefab office.

lines.japanese: ここの係員はみな還暦を越えているようなじいさんばかりだった。どのじいさんも区の条例違反者を迎える立場とは思えないほどにこやかで愛想良く、腰も曲げずにきびきび動いている。
lines.english: Every attendant looked past sixty. For men whose job was to deal with violations of ward rules, they were remarkably cheerful and friendly, and every one of them moved briskly without a stoop.

lines.japanese: プレハブ小屋の窓口で、鳴は定められた手数料を支払い、引き取り手続きを進める。俺は出入り口のそばで働き者の老人たちを眺めながら、やつが戻ってくるのをぼんやり待った。
lines.english: At the prefab window, Naru paid the prescribed fee and completed the collection procedure. I waited absentmindedly by the entrance, watching the industrious old men until she returned.

lines.japanese: ふと思いだす。そういやフレイムバーズとＲ－ウィングの悪ガキたちは、まだ柳木原の自転車泥棒を探してるんだろうか。
lines.english: Something occurred to me. Were the Flame Birds and those R-Wing brats still searching Yanagihara for the bicycle thief?

lines.japanese: ……まあ、ほっとくか。ある意味、社会奉仕活動だし。
lines.english: ...Well, leave them to it. In a sense, it was community service.

lines.japanese: 「次のニュースです。アルバトロス前の男性射殺事件に関与していると見て、警察は２日夜、浜島組系暴力団組員の男を逮捕しました」
lines.english: “And now our next story. On the night of the second, police arrested a man affiliated with the Hamajima-gumi, believing him involved in the fatal shooting outside the Albatross.”

lines.japanese: 詰所の大きな窓からはラジオ越しの曇ったアナウンサーの声が漏れていて、俺のおぼろげだった推測を明確な事実へと昇華させていた。
lines.english: The announcer's muffled voice leaked through the office's broad window, turning my hazy suspicion into established fact.

lines.japanese: 「調べによると男性は美空区の自由業・江藤弘之さん２３歳で、江藤さんは急ぎ美空総合病院へ運ばれましたが、出血多量などにより二時間後に死亡しました──」
lines.english: “Police have identified the man as Hiroyuki Eto, twenty-three, a self-employed resident of Misora Ward. Mr. Eto was rushed to Misora General Hospital but died two hours later from blood loss and related complications—”

lines.japanese: 「──美空署は目撃者の証言などから、浜島組系暴力団『龍声社』の構成員・飯田哲史容疑者３５歳を殺人などの疑いで逮捕しました」
lines.english: “—Based on eyewitness statements and other evidence, Misora police arrested thirty-five-year-old Satoshi Iida, a member of the Ryuseisha, an organization affiliated with the Hamajima-gumi, on suspicion of murder and related offenses.”

lines.japanese: 「調べによると飯田容疑者は、事件の一週間ほど前、江藤さんにバールのようなもので後頭部を殴られ、その際、違法所持していた拳銃を江藤さんに奪われており、そのことを恨んで犯行に及んだものと見られています」
lines.english: “Investigators say that roughly one week before the incident, Eto struck Iida in the back of the head with an object resembling a crowbar and took a handgun Iida possessed illegally. Police believe Iida killed him in retaliation.”

lines.japanese: 「飯田容疑者は取り調べに対し、大筋で犯行を認めており『素人に組の面子を潰され腹が立った。汚名を晴らしたので後悔はしていない』などと供述しています」
lines.english: “Iida has broadly admitted the crime, reportedly telling investigators, ‘An amateur humiliated our organization and made me angry. I've cleared our name. I have no regrets.’”

lines.japanese: 「なお、殺害された江藤さんの自宅からは大量のホラービデオや各国のカルト的宗教に関する文献などが発見されており、心療内科や精神科への通院歴もあることなどから、警察では江藤さんの責任能力について──」
lines.english: “Police also discovered a large collection of horror videos and literature on cult religions from around the world in Eto's home. In light of his history of treatment at psychosomatic and psychiatric clinics, police are investigating Eto's criminal responsibility—”

lines.japanese: 「ふいー、お待たせしましたー」
lines.english: “Whew. Sorry to keep you waiting.”

lines.japanese: 未舗装の砂利の上、鳴が片手ずつハンドルとサドルに添えて真っ赤なチャリを転がしてくる。俺はラジオの声を頭から締めだし、笑顔で首を縦に振ってみせた。
lines.english: Naru rolled the bright-red bicycle over the unpaved gravel, one hand on the bars and one on the saddle. I shut the radio voice out of my head and greeted her with a smiling nod.

lines.japanese: 「ん、もういいの」
lines.english: “Hm. All done?”

lines.japanese: 「はいー」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「──あ、や、ちょっと待ってください？」
lines.english: “—Oh, wait a moment.”

lines.japanese: やつは入場門を出る前にはたと立ちどまり、スタンドを立ててその場に自転車を停めた。
lines.english: She stopped short before passing through the entrance gate, lowered the kickstand, and parked the bicycle there.

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「あーいえ、ちょっとー」
lines.english: “Oh, nothing. Just a moment.”

lines.japanese: 俺の疑問には曖昧に答えつつ、チャリの前面に周りこんだ。例の消防服みたいな素材のポーチをふぁさりと開ける。
lines.english: Answering vaguely, she went around the bike’s front and flipped open the sealed pouch.

lines.japanese: まあ、そうだろう。あれの確認だろう。
lines.english: Well, of course. She was checking for that.

lines.japanese: 俺は鳴の横に立って共にポーチの中を覗きこんだ。うるせえな、いいんだよ、俺にはそのぐらいの権利あるだろ。締まんねえオチだろうが、一応最後までは見届けさせろよ。
lines.english: I stood beside Naru and looked into the pouch with her. Shut up. I had at least that much right. Pathetic punch line or not, let me see this through to the end.

lines.japanese: これが成田工務店、最後のヤマだしな。
lines.english: This was Narita Construction's final job, after all.

lines.japanese: 「はぁぁ……良かった、あったー」
lines.english: “Aah... Thank goodness. It's here.”

lines.japanese: 柔らかそうな直方体の底には、飲みかけの５００ミリペットや女ものの折り畳み傘なんかに紛れて、小さなビニールケースを着込んだ小さな端末が転がっていた。
lines.english: At the bottom of the soft rectangular pouch, amid a half-finished half-liter plastic bottle and a woman’s folding umbrella, lay a tiny device in a little plastic case.

lines.japanese: 「うぅ～んもう、私のポケベルぅ～ん」
lines.english: “Mmm, my darling pager...”

lines.japanese: 拾いあげてケースから剥き、愛しげに頬を擦りよせている。
lines.english: She picked it up, peeled away the case, and rubbed it lovingly against her cheek.

lines.japanese: 「良かったな」
lines.english: “Good for you.”

lines.japanese: いつも適当に言ってる言葉だから重みが出なかったけれど、俺はやつの嬉しそうな顔を見て本当にそう思ったんだ。
lines.english: I said that all the time, so it didn't carry much weight, but when I saw her happy face, I really meant it.

lines.japanese: 「はいー。長いことご協力ありがとうございましたー」
lines.english: Yeees. Thank you very much for all your help over this long, long tiiime.

lines.japanese: 「いや、まあ、いいけど」
lines.english: “Sure. It's fine.”

lines.japanese: 目を伏せて、後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: I lowered my eyes and raked the back of my head.

lines.japanese: あの薄っぺらい板の中に、ゆうべ自分の送った一言が入ってるのかと思うと緊張する。果たして俺は、見事にやつの母親を演じられたのだろうか。
lines.english: The thought that the thin little slab held the line I'd sent last night made me nervous. Had I succeeded in playing her mother?

lines.japanese: 気付いたみたいだ。鳴は視界に画面情報が入ったとき、わざわざその驚きを声に載せた。
lines.english: She had noticed. The moment something on the screen caught her eye, Naru made a point of voicing her surprise.

lines.japanese: 「あれー、メッセージ届いてるー」
lines.english: “Oh, I have a message.”

lines.japanese: 「へー」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: もちろん俺はシラを切った。
lines.english: Naturally, I played innocent.

lines.japanese: 「なにおまえ、どうせ誰からも届かないとか言ってたくせに。んーだよ、嘘じゃん。届くんじゃん」
lines.english: “You said nobody ever sent you anything. What the hell? That was a lie. Messages do come.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、あー、そっかー」
lines.english: “Oh. Ah, I see.”

lines.japanese: やつはぽっかり口を開けて、いったん画面から顔を上げた。
lines.english: Mouth falling open, she raised her face from the screen for a moment.

lines.japanese: 「や、本当にいままでは来なかったんですけどー、これ多分あれです、さっき亜衣ちゃんとパルさんに番号教えたんでー、さっそく送ってくれたんだと思います」
lines.english: “No, really, I'd never gotten one before. I think it's probably because I gave Ai and Paru my number earlier, so one of them must've sent me something right away.”

lines.japanese: 「え……あ、そうなの。いやでも、実はそれだけじゃねーかもよ」
lines.english: “What...? Oh, right. But maybe it isn't only them.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 米粒みたいなボタンを操作していた鳴が、一度ちらりと俺を見上げ──しかしまたすぐポケベルに視線を戻した。
lines.english: Working the rice-grain-sized buttons, Naru glanced up at me once—then immediately returned her gaze to the pager.

lines.japanese: 「え……あれ、４件も来てる」
lines.english: “What... There are four messages.”

lines.japanese: 「マジで」
lines.english: “Seriously?”

lines.japanese: なんだよ、考えることはみんな同じかよ。ふん、亜衣もパルさんも暇だな。
lines.english: So everybody had thought of the same thing. Hmph. Ai and Paru had too much time on their hands.

lines.japanese: 横長のディスプレイに目を凝らしていた鳴の首が、大きくこてんと傾いた。
lines.english: Naru's head tipped dramatically to one side as she peered at the long, narrow display.

lines.japanese: 「ん？　ん？　んんー？」
lines.english: “Hm? Hm? Hmmm?”

lines.japanese: 首の角度を変えたり、ポケベルを近付けたり離したりしながら、やつは眉をひそめてうんうん唸る。
lines.english: Changing the angle of her neck, moving the pager nearer and farther, she frowned and hummed in confusion.

lines.japanese: 「え、なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、やー、誰かのいたずらでしょうか。一件目、いきなり奇怪な文章が」
lines.english: “Hmm. I wonder if somebody's playing a prank. The first message opens with a bizarre sentence.”

lines.japanese: 「奇怪な文章？」
lines.english: “A bizarre sentence?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんだろーこれ、亜衣ちゃんかなー」
lines.english: Huhhh, what's this? Maybe it's from Aiii?

lines.japanese: 「あー、まー、そういうくだらねえことすんのは亜衣だろ。しょーがねえなあ、ちょ、読んでみ」
lines.english: Yeah, well, Ai's the one who'd pull dumb crap like that. Geez. C'mon, read it.

lines.japanese: 「『ゲンキデガンバレ　ハマヨリ』」
lines.english: “KEEP YOUR SPIRITS UP AND DO YOUR BEST. FROM MATHER.”

lines.japanese: なんか覚えのあるメッセージだな。
lines.english: That message felt somehow familiar.

lines.japanese: ──って、いや、ソレ俺じゃん。つか奇怪な文章じゃなくて、単なる入力ミスじゃん。
lines.english: —Wait. No. That was mine. And it wasn't bizarre; it was just a typo.

lines.japanese: 「ハマヨリ……はー、なんですかねハマヨリってー」
lines.english: “Mather... What on earth is Mather?”

lines.japanese: いや、そりゃおまえアレだ。母かママか迷った挙句、一文字ずつ混在しちゃったんだよ。
lines.english: No, see, it's that thing. I couldn't decide between ‘Mother’ and ‘Mama,’ so I mixed 'em up a letter at a time. Hence ‘Mather.’

lines.japanese: ──なんて説明するわけにもいかない。
lines.english: —Not that I could explain that.

lines.japanese: 「いや、そりゃおまえアレだ。浜頼さんだろ」
lines.english: “No, that's, uh... That's gotta be Hamayori.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえな、いいんだよ誰でも。この文章の主題はそこじゃねーんだよ、もっと第一段落の行間に注目しろよ」
lines.english: Shut up, who cares who it's from? That's not the point of the message. Look harder between the lines of paragraph one!

lines.japanese: 「あー、やっぱりパルさんから来てるー」
lines.english: “Oh, there really is one from Paru.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょちょちょ、待てっておまえ。次行くの早ええって。いいから一件目の文章もっと噛めよ。ソレたぶん噛めば噛むほど味出てくんだよ」
lines.english: “Whoa, whoa, wait. You’re moving on too fast. Chew on that first message a little longer. I bet it gets better the more you chew.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、やった亜衣ちゃんからもー」
lines.english: “Ah, wonderful. One from Ai too.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、亜衣ちゃんからもじゃなくて。おーコラ、浜頼シカトこいてんじゃねーぞてめ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Not ‘one from Ai too.’ Hey, don’t you ignore Mather, you little shit. I’ll kill you!”
“Ah.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 鳴の言葉がやんだ。口を開けて、じっと画面を凝視している。
lines.english: Naru stopped talking. Her mouth hung open as she stared at the screen.

lines.japanese: 「なに。なんだよ」
lines.english: “What? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「え……あれ？　あれ、あはっ」
lines.english: “What... Huh? Huh—ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 呆けた表情に戸惑いが滲み、吹きだすような笑みがこぼれた。
lines.english: Her dazed look gave way to confusion, and then a smile broke through.

lines.japanese: 「だから、どうしたっての」
lines.english: “I said, what happened?”

lines.japanese: 「あ──いえいえ、すみませんちょっと」
lines.english: “Ah—no, no, sorry. Just a second.”

lines.japanese: 鳴はおもてを上げて俺に締まりのないニヤケ面を見せたあと、また飽きもせず視線を落とした。
lines.english: Naru looked up and flashed me a sloppy grin, then dropped her eyes again like she'd never get tired of looking.

lines.japanese: 「たはは」
lines.english: “Hee hee.”

lines.japanese: くすぐったいような、はにかむような笑顔。小さな端末の載ったてのひらが、柔らかく開いたり閉じたりしている。
lines.english: A shy, almost tickled smile. The hand holding the tiny device opened and closed softly around it.

lines.japanese: 「なに。なんだよ気持ち悪りぃな」
lines.english: “What? What's with that creepy face?”

lines.japanese: 俺は大袈裟に頭を引きながら、やつが頬緩ませるそのディスプレイを斜めにちらりと見下ろした。横一列にびっしりと、カナ文字じゃなくてアルファベットが並んでいた。
lines.english: I drew back theatrically and stole a sidelong glance at the display that had put that smile on her face. The narrow screen was filled end to end with Roman letters instead of Japanese characters.

lines.japanese: 「あん？　なにそれ。なんて書いてあんの」
lines.english: “Huh? What's that? What does it say?”

lines.japanese: 「『Ｉｎ　ｃｅｌｅｂｒａｔｉｏｎ　ｏｆ　ｙｏｕｒ　ｂｉｒｔｈｄａｙ，ｄｅａｒ　ＲＯＯ』」
lines.english: “‘In celebration of your birthday, dear ROO.’”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　え、なに？　ルウ？」
lines.english: “Huh? What? Roo?”

lines.japanese: 意味が分からない。俺は左右の眉を上下に広げた。
lines.english: I didn't understand. One brow climbed as the other fell.

lines.japanese: だけどまあ、バースデイって単語が聞こえたし鳴は喜んでるみたいだしで、要はお誕生日おめでとうってことなんだろう。
lines.english: Still, I'd heard the word *birthday*, and Naru looked happy, so the gist was probably happy birthday.

lines.japanese: 「なにそれ。誰から」
lines.english: “What's that? Who sent it?”

lines.japanese: 「さー、誰なんでしょねー、差出人の名前ないですけどー」
lines.english: “Who knows? There's no sender's name.”

lines.japanese: 鳴はくすくす笑いながらポケベルをポーチに戻す。それから自転車のハンドルを掴み、右足でスタンドを起こした。
lines.english: Giggling, Naru returned the pager to its pouch. Then she took the handlebars and kicked up the stand with her right foot.

lines.japanese: 「お世話さまでしたー」
lines.english: “Thank you for your help.”

lines.japanese: プレハブ詰所にへこっとお辞儀してから、やつは自転車を押して歩きだした。外に立ってたじいさんが手を振っている。俺も軽く会釈してから鳴のあとに続いた。
lines.english: After bobbing a bow toward the prefab office, she began walking the bicycle away. The old man outside waved. I gave him a small nod and followed.

lines.japanese: 「いま思いだしたんですけどー」
lines.english: “I just remembered something.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あの私ー、小さいころ家族に『るー』って呼ばれてたんですよー」
lines.english: “Um, meee... When I was little, my family used to call me Roo.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　ああ、へえ、そうなん」
lines.english: “What? Oh. Huh. That so?”

lines.japanese: やつが唐突に話を変えるから、俺はいつものようにひらりと聞きながしそうになった。
lines.english: She changed the subject so abruptly that I nearly let it sail past as usual.

lines.japanese: しかし、一瞬遅れて思いあたる。
lines.english: But a moment later, something clicked.

lines.japanese: 家族……？
lines.english: Family...?

lines.japanese: 「え。じゃなに、さっきのアレって、おまえのかーちゃんが──」
lines.english: “Wait. Then that message just now—your mom sent it—”

lines.japanese: 「んー、さー、どうなんでしょうねえ。それはないと思いますけどー」
lines.english: “Hmm. Who knows? I don't think so.”

lines.japanese: 赤いフレームをまたいで、やつのケツが背もたれ付きのシートにすっぽり収まる。
lines.english: She swung a leg over the red frame, and her ass fit right into the seat with the backrest.

lines.japanese: 「え、だって……あァ？　なんだ、つまりアレか……？」
lines.english: “What, but... Huh? Then does that mean...?”

lines.japanese: 歩みを止めている俺に気付かず、鳴が保管所の敷地外へ向かってのろのろとペダルを漕ぎだした。俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻きながら、下を向いて舌打ちをひとつした。
lines.english: Without noticing I'd stopped, Naru began pedaling slowly toward the edge of the impound lot. Raking the back of my head, I looked down and clicked my tongue.

lines.japanese: 「──のヤロウ」
lines.english: “—That bastard.”

lines.japanese: あのむっつりシスコン……俺が頼んだときゃガタガタ屁理屈並べてたくせに、結局やるこたやってんじゃねえか。はッ、まったく素直じゃねえ。
lines.english: That secretly sister-obsessed bastard... When I asked him, he piled excuse on excuse, but in the end he'd done it after all. Hah. Couldn't be honest to save his life.

lines.japanese: ああ、上等だよクソが。おかげでハマヨリ形無しだっつうの。
lines.english: Fine. Damn it. Now Mather looked completely pathetic.

lines.japanese: 「隼人さーん？　行かないんですかー、置いていきますよー」
lines.english: “Hayato? Aren't you coming? I'll leave you behind.”

lines.japanese: よろよろ徐行しながら、鳴が肩越しに振りかえった。
lines.english: Wobbling along at a crawl, Naru looked back over her shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「……っせえな、行くっつうの。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “...Shut up. I'm coming. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 俺は二本指を突きつけて踏みだした。乾いた砂利が鳴った。
lines.english: I thrust two fingers at her and stepped forward. Dry gravel crunched beneath my feet.

lines.japanese: いやまあ、なんでもいいんだ。あいつがあんな、締まりのない顔でへらへら笑ってんならそれで。
lines.english: Whatever. None of that mattered. If it made her grin like that, all loose and stupid, fine by me.

lines.japanese: 「ちょー、もー、なにへらへら笑ってるんですかー。早く早くー」
lines.english: “Hey, come on. Why are you grinning? Hurry, hurry.”

lines.japanese: 鳴の自転車は超低速を維持するため、よろよろふるふると危なっかしく揺れていた。
lines.english: To keep crawling along at super-low speed, Naru's bike wibble-wobbled all over the place.

lines.japanese: 「ほらほら！　ほらっ、もたもたしてると鳴さんどっか行っちゃうぞーほら！」
lines.english: “Come on! Keep dawdling and Naru's gonna ride away without you!”

lines.japanese: 「……うわ、うぜえー」
lines.english: “God, you're annoying.”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの後輪に一蹴りくれて加速させた。
lines.english: I gave her rear wheel a kick and sent it speeding forward.
“Whoooa!?”

lines.japanese: そのまま漕ぎはじめる鳴を、俺も少し速足で追いかけた。
lines.english: As Naru began pedaling, I followed at a quicker walk.

lines.japanese: やつは背もたれに身を預けて優雅にペダルを漕ぎながら、八重歯の覗く笑顔でちらちらと振りかえる。なんだか青春ごっこみたいでムズ痒い。
lines.english: Leaning against the backrest as she pedaled, she kept glancing back with one pointed tooth showing in her smile. It felt like playing at young love, and it made me squirm.

lines.japanese: 「隼人さん遅いですよー！」
lines.english: “You're too slow, Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、いいんだよ。いいから、いちいちこっち見んな。馬鹿ップルみたいでもじもじしちゃうだろ」
lines.english: “Shut up. It's fine. Just quit looking back every five seconds. You're making me feel like half of some idiot couple.”

lines.japanese: 「走れ隼人ー！」
lines.english: “Run, Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「うっせ、呼び捨てすんな」
lines.english: “Shut up. Don't get familiar.”

lines.japanese: 「走れ成田ー！」
lines.english: “Run, Narita!”

lines.japanese: 「呼び捨てすんなっつの」
lines.english: Quit calling me Hayato like that.

lines.japanese: 「走れ浜頼ー！」
lines.english: “Run, Mather!”

lines.japanese: 「呼び捨てすんなっつんだよ。つか、えええ、浜頼バレてんのかよ」
lines.english: “I said quit it—wait, what? You figured out Mather?”

lines.japanese: <8>\「浜頼好きだー！」
lines.english: “I love you, Mather!”

lines.japanese: 「しかも浜頼締めかよ」
lines.english: “And Mather gets the final word?”

lines.japanese: ひでえオチだ。
lines.english: What a shitty punch line.

lines.japanese: 「あーはははーっ！　胸が高鳴るーっ！」
lines.english: “Ahahahaha! My heart is racing!”
